initial_pressure_guard.result: Guard exceeded; all five guest jobs healthy, no host OOM, ARC reclaimed. Cleanup restored the original grants and custom 2 GiB cap.
initial_pressure_guard.followup: Longer native Automatic run failed with substantial paging, so the selected custom 2 GiB policy was tested separately; Automatic was not promoted.

limits: This pressure run validates one lab profile/workload; it is not a universal OOM or latency guarantee.
Lab floor is 4 GiB operating RAM and one complete physical core; final selected CPU reserve is two cores.
Guest memory budget is rounded down to whole GiB; residual physical memory remains unissued.
ARC maximum is elastic and not counted as an additional reservation.
Native Automatic caused substantial host paging under this workload and remains opt-in; the validated lab default is a custom 2 GiB cap.
Actual automatic zero-parameter module-load behavior is unit-tested, not tested by the final physical reboot, which verifies the selected custom cap.
Native Automatic defaults reviewed for Linux OpenZFS 2.0-2.4; a managed Automatic policy on an unknown version fails closed until local root review.
Pool floor is operating headroom, not a ZFS reservation or protection from arbitrary unmanaged writes.
Single connected host; fleet aggregation and off-host backup remain deferred.
Provider sign-in metadata and T3 reachability checked after this host reboot; no new paid provider task was submitted.
